h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hazaribagh

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hazaribagh

items.pText: Hazaribagh is a plateau town in Jharkhand, greener and a little cooler than the plains, with forests and lakes around it and a long tradition of schools and colleges. Many school and colony sites here are not flat. The ground rises and falls, and rock often sits just below the soil. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, about 1,380 km away, and sends it to Jharkhand by road.

Uneven ground need not stop you from building a good play area. It means the levels have to be planned before the equipment is chosen. We ask for photos from several angles and a rough idea of the slope, then suggest where to cut a level platform and which pieces fit on it. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India sets the equipment in place, grouted into the ground or self-standing on a prepared base.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Working with a sloping or rocky site

c: Each piece of equipment and its safe play area must sit on level ground, so a slope usually becomes two or three terraces with steps or a ramp between them. Put the youngest children's pieces on the lowest level, where they are easiest to watch. Where rock lies close to the surface, foundation pits may need to be cut into it, and we plan post positions to avoid the hardest patches. Give every terrace an outlet for rainwater, since monsoon runoff on a slope moves fast.

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed on sloping ground?
items.a: Yes, once the slope is cut into level platforms. Each piece and its safe play area needs flat ground, so we plan the terraces with you and place the equipment on them.

items.q: What if there is rock just under the soil?
items.a: Foundation pits can be cut into rock, though it takes more work. We study your site photos and plan post positions to avoid the hardest areas where possible.
Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Hazaribagh by road. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India installs it according to the layout drawing you approve.
